task.title: Support short array syntax in ConfigParser
task.description: ConfigParser (core/classes/ConfigParser.class.php), used by adm_config_report.php to parse configuration values, only accepts array( ... ): the input "[ NEW_ => REPORTER ]" throws 'Unexpected token "["', although it is valid PHP. Add support for [ ... ] arrays, including nested ones and mixed with array( ... ), without using eval().
acceptance: ConfigParser::parse() returns array( NEW_ => REPORTER ) for the input "[ NEW_ => REPORTER ]" and array( 'a' => array( 1, 2 ) ) for "[ 'a' => [ 1, 2 ] ]".
New tests for these cases and for an unclosed '[' (which must throw an Exception) are added to tests/Unit/ConfigParserUnitTest.php.
composer run check-fast passes, and tests/Mantis/ConfigParserTest.php still passes in composer run check.

acceptance.criterion: ConfigParser::parse() returns array( NEW_ => REPORTER ) for "[ NEW_ => REPORTER ]" and array( 'a' => array( 1, 2 ) ) for "[ 'a' => [ 1, 2 ] ]".
acceptance.evidence: testShortArrayConstants and testShortArrayNested (assertSame) pass: `vendor/bin/phpunit --no-configuration --bootstrap vendor/autoload.php tests/Unit/ConfigParserUnitTest.php` -> OK (6 tests, 6 assertions).

acceptance.criterion: New tests for these cases and for an unclosed '[' (which must throw an Exception) are added to tests/Unit/ConfigParserUnitTest.php.
acceptance.evidence: tests/Unit/ConfigParserUnitTest.php created with testShortArrayConstants, testShortArrayNested, testShortArrayUnclosed (expectException Exception), plus mixed, empty and mismatched-bracket cases; all pass.

acceptance.criterion: composer run check-fast passes, and tests/Mantis/ConfigParserTest.php still passes in composer run check.
acceptance.evidence: Not verifiable: composer.json in this worktree has no 'scripts' section, so neither check-fast nor check exists. `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter ConfigParserTest` fails with 'Cannot open bootstrap script tests/bootstrap.php', and there is no config/config_inc.php or DB. Substitute check: an inline php -r script loaded the providers and error cases of tests/Mantis/ConfigParserTest.php and compared the parser output with eval() and the var_export round trip: '53 cases, 0 failures'. Both changed files pass `php -l`.

human_needed.question: Where do `composer run check-fast` / `composer run check`, phpunit.unit.xml and tests/Unit/ come from? Should this branch add them, or must it be rebased onto a branch that already has them?
human_needed.why: The acceptance criteria and the implement-change skill depend on these gates, but they are not in this worktree. Inventing their content (which linters, which suites, the Docker setup) would be guessing a team decision.

gaps.problem: No 'scripts' section: `composer run check-fast`, `composer run check` and `composer run setup`, which the task and the implement-change skill name, do not exist in this worktree.

Missing, along with tests/Unit/. The skill says to run `vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.unit.xml`; I had to use `--no-configuration --bootstrap vendor/autoload.php` and require constant_inc.php and the class files from the test itself.

Points to tests/bootstrap.php, which does not exist (only bootstrap.php.sample). No config/config_inc.php or DB either, so tests/Mantis/ConfigParserTest.php cannot run locally, and nothing documents how to set up the environment without the missing `check` script.
The skill links docs/product.md, docs/architecture.md, AGENTS.md and docs/harness/log.md. None of them exist in this worktree; the skill itself is loaded from a sibling checkout (../repo/.claude).
Writing a temporary helper script under /tmp was denied by permissions, so I ran the ad hoc regression check inline with `php -r`.

summary: ConfigParser::process_array() now accepts short `[ ... ]` arrays as well as `array( ... )`. This works at the top level, for nested values, for keyed values, and when the two syntaxes are mixed. The closing token (']' or ')') is tracked for each array level, and no eval() is used. I added tests/Unit/ConfigParserUnitTest.php with 6 tests (the two required inputs, mixed syntax, empty `[]`, unclosed '[', and '[' closed by ')'), and they pass with PHPUnit run by hand. The gates named in the task do not exist in this worktree: there is no `check-fast` or `check` composer script, no phpunit.unit.xml, no tests/bootstrap.php and no config_inc.php or database. So I could not run them, and the status is partial. As a stand-in, I ran every data and error case from tests/Mantis/ConfigParserTest.php directly against the parser without a database: 53 cases, 0 failures.
